title: LLMs: A Driving Force in Next Generation Digital Design Automation
authors_status: publisher page did not expose authors in captured result
structured_summary: Reviews applications of generative AI and LLMs in silicon design automation, assesses qualitative readiness for automating design tasks, and identifies future research directions.
problem: How can language models support or automate stages of digital silicon design?
method_or_artifact: survey and qualitative readiness analysis of LLM-enabled design tasks
evaluation_or_evidence: qualitative readiness assessment; quantitative paper-level evidence not yet extracted
limits: A review and readiness analysis is not evidence that the proposed tasks are production-ready or broadly adopted.

title: EVA: An Efficient and Versatile Generative Engine for Targeted Discovery of Novel Analog Circuits
structured_summary: Uses a decoder-only transformer to generate circuit topologies and applies PPO and DPO fine-tuning for targeted discovery of high-performing analog circuits.
problem: How can novel analog circuit topologies be generated and targeted toward useful performance?
method_or_artifact: generative circuit-topology engine with pretraining and preference-based fine-tuning
evaluation_or_evidence: reports validity, novelty, versatility, and training/discovery efficiency; exact tables and baselines pending extraction
limits: Publisher metadata and abstract support the method description but do not establish generalization across processes, circuit classes, or industrial flows.

title: Automated Accelerator Optimization Aided by Graph Neural Networks
structured_summary: Uses graph neural networks as a surrogate for expensive HLS evaluation in accelerator design-space exploration, reporting millisecond prediction and up to 79x speedup, with 48x average speedup in the publisher abstract.
problem: How can high-level-synthesis accelerator optimization explore a large design space without repeatedly paying expensive tool evaluation cost?
method_or_artifact: graph representation of HLS designs plus learned surrogate model for design-space exploration
evaluation_or_evidence: reported speedup relative to HLS-based optimization; benchmark and error details pending extraction
limits: The reported speedup is paper-specific and does not establish equivalent quality, transfer, or production benefit for other HLS tools and workloads.
